citations.claim: first violating step: total energy explodes to ~23888 J vs E0 ~1790 J
initial energy before collision is only ~1790 J with no controller work
just before impact the light body still carries the full incoming x-velocity

counterfactual.change: reduced body 1 initial vx from -47.877 to -5.0 (same 7 steps); collision becomes gentle and energy stays bounded, showing high-speed impact triggers the injection

explanation: Light fast body (m=1, vx~-48) strikes near-stationary heavy body (m~16.9). Between step 6 (separated, energy ~1790) and step 7 (touching gap 0.046) the contact impulse/positional correction creates large spurious velocity: heavy body jumps to speed ~51 (vx~-43.8, vy~-26.6) and light body keeps speed ~45 instead of bouncing, raising x-momentum ~16x and energy 1790->23888 with zero controller work. The spurious -y kick despite zero pre-impact relative y-velocity points to normal impulse/positional-correction energy injection on a fast heavy-light contact, not to external work or restitution (both e<1).
vision_note: Two free circles drift closer over steps 4 to 6 and first make contact in step 7 with a small downward shift. No walls, waypoints, controller body, or large positional jump is visible, so the failure is not visible as an explosion but as contact onset.
